verdict.rationale: The ElevenLabs Agents build overview states that developers can upload documents and enable RAG for grounded responses. That covers a built-in knowledge base, retrieval, and answers grounded in the user's content. The evidence is only a single overview line, with no deeper documentation. Missing for 10: detailed knowledge-base docs (supported file types, size limits, API/CLI management of documents, retrieval configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content

citations.quote: Upload documents and enable RAG for grounded responses
